result.topic_en: Riemann discusses the linear relations among the differentials dz_ν arising from the vanishing sums of Abelian differentials, introduces the integrals w_π with their periodicity moduli k_π^ν across the cross-cuts, and defines congruence of systems of p quantities modulo the 2p systems of associated period moduli.
